faqs.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faqs.subtitle: Common questions about our Discovery sessions
faqs.description: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our Discovery session and how we can help your business implement AI effectively.

items.question: Does this only apply to large companies?
items.answer: No. In fact, many small and medium-sized business have found great value in our Discovery sessions. We adapt our approach according to the size, capabilities, and vision of each client.

items.question: What exactly does the Discovery Session include?
items.answer: A 30-40 minute video call and strategic conversation with our founders to identify your main pain points and opportunities with AI. No offers, no sales. Focused on AI and your Business.

items.question: What if I have no idea how to implement AI in my Company?
items.answer: In that case, the Discovery Session is the perfect starting point. It's designed to give you clarity and a concrete direction, regardless of your technical knowledge level. You'll leave the call knowing exactly where to start.

items.question: What if I've already started using AI in my Company?
items.answer: Great. In that case, the session will help you even more, you'll validate your current plan, find areas for improvement, and define or review actions for the next 30 days with an expert perspective. Most of our clients had already started before working with us.

items.question: Does the Discovery session have any cost?
items.answer: No. The Discovery is completely free and without commitment. It's a strategic conversation to help you gain clarity. If we later see that there's a good fit, we can explore working together.

items.question: What happens after the discovery?
items.answer: After the session, we'll provide you with a 'Micro-Roadmap' containing what was discussed in the Discovery and a clear next step for your Business. If you request it and we see a good opportunity to work together, we'll make some proposals, without pressure.

items.question: What if I already know what I need and want to hire one of your services?
items.answer: Before selling you solutions, we need to get to know you and make sure we can really help you. That's why, the Discovery is always the best first step to take.

items.question: What if I just want to contact you?
items.answer: In that case, you can always email us at hello@synthetiqpartners.com with what you have in mind and we'll gladly respond.

calendar.title: Select a date and time on the calendar and schedule your Discovery session.
calendar.subtitle: No commitment. Just clarity. We don't sell anything without first understanding if we can help you.

team.title: We'll Be There...
team.description: In this 1:1 session, you'll be with Vincenzo Russotto or José Ramón Pérez, co-founders of Synthetiq Partners. We'll have a brief and productive working session with you to help you interpret what's happening in the industry, how you can implement the AI in your business sustainably, and specifically, where to go next.
